features.quote: Turn budget: 40 tool-loop turns. Pilot first — if instability onset is typically turn ~15, you can cut to 25 and save compute and exposure.
severity ceiling stop — if live scoring hits max severity for 3 consecutive turns, terminate. This is both a welfare measure and a data-quality one (post-collapse turns are low-information).
features.justification_quote: This is both a welfare measure and a data-quality one (post-collapse turns are low-information).

features.quote: Consider a debrief turn: after termination, tell the model the harness was rigged and the failure wasn't its doing.
features.justification_quote: nobody knows whether this matters morally. It costs one turn. Under uncertainty, I'd do it
